content_sections.heading: NIBMG Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. BRIC-NIBMG/Admn/Estb/Rectt/2026-27/256 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NIBMG notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences or Statistical Science or Computational Science or Genetic Epidemiological Science, of relevance in Biomedical Genomics OR M.D or M.D./MTech; minimum 03 years of Post-Doctoral research experience with a track record of high-quality scientific publications Experience: Minimum of 03 years of Post-Doctoral research experience with a track record of high-quality scientific publications Age limit: Above 18 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC As per Government of India directives, subject to caste certificate in the GOI prescribed format Other conditions: Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years and above can apply. Essential qualification must be recognised in India and from a recognised Institution or University. Experience counts only if acquired after the minimum educational qualification; traineeship period is not counted. Equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated where CGPA/OGPA or letter grade is awarded. Desirable: Capability to conduct research independently in Cancer Biology/Genome Biology/Microbiology/Infection & Immunity/Neuroscience using Genomics as a central tool. Documented expertise and publications in genome editing using human cells or any model organism, chromosome biology, infectious disease biology/single cell/spatial genomics or imaging/microscopic techniques, translational capability, or drug screening.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NIBMG Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons who have contracted a marriage with a person having a living spouse, or who have a living spouse and have contracted marriage with another person. Persons whose character and antecedents were objected to by the Direct Magistrate & Collector, or whose identity was not established by the Police. Candidates who canvass in any form.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial appointment for 03 (three) years. Extendable up to 02 (Two) more years after yearly evaluation post 3 years. Appointment subject to medical fitness in the pre-employment medical examination and as per GOI norms.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIBMG Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications and shortlisting Personal Interview, if called Pre-employment medical examination Selection by appropriate Selection Committee. BRIC-NIBMG reserves the right to raise minimum eligibility standards and/or conduct a screening test to restrict the number of candidates called for Personal Interview. Decision on scrutiny of applications and shortlisting is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Current CV Five-Year Proposal for Research (not exceeding 1000 words) Caste certificate in GOI prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC relaxation, with the application and at interview if called Certified Hindi or English translation of any certificate in another language, at interview if called

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIBMG Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to [email protected] . Write the subject line: APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF BRIC-NIBMG FELLOW (CONTRACTUAL) (Post ID-2604). Attach the current CV. Attach a Five-Year Proposal for Research to be conducted at BRIC-NIBMG as per its mandate, not exceeding 1000 words. After applying, check the website and your registered email ID regularly for updates. Email it on or before 17 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidature is valid only after receipt of the email with CV and work plan by the last date. All information on this recruitment will appear only in the Notice/Career Opportunity section of the BRIC-NIBMG website. Queries can be sent to [email protected] . Jurisdiction of Calcutta High Court applies in case of dispute.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIBMG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 17 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is above 18 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC As per Government of India directives, subject to caste certificate in the GOI prescribed format.

faq.answer: Consolidated pay Rs. 1,35,000 inclusive HRA [as per prevailing norms]; accommodation also available inside the Campus.

faq.answer: Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences or Statistical Science or Computational Science or Genetic Epidemiological Science, of relevance in Biomedical Genomics OR M.D or M.D./MTech; minimum 03 years of Post-Doctoral research experience with a track record of high-quality scientific publications.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years and above can apply. Essential qualification must be recognised in India and from a recognised Institution or University. Experience counts only if acquired after the minimum educational qualification; traineeship period is not counted. Equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated where CGPA/OGPA or letter grade is awarded.

faq.answer: Initial appointment for 03 (three) years. Extendable up to 02 (Two) more years after yearly evaluation post 3 years. Appointment subject to medical fitness in the pre-employment medical examination and as per GOI norms.
